Q6144.reason: Under Miller, nudity alone is not obscene; the work must be patently offensive sexual conduct, and mere nude sunbathing portrayals don't meet that.

Q6146.reason: Sixth Amendment counsel right attaches only at critical stages after adversary proceedings begin, so pre-charge investigative surveillance is not covered.

Q6151.reason: Glycogen phosphorylase cleaves glycogen to glucose-1-phosphate, which phosphoglucomutase later converts to glucose-6-phosphate.
